mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_page WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND title LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'
SELECT page_id::TEXT AS row_id, title, context, use_yn FROM t_page WHERE page_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_page (title, context, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{title}, #{context}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_page SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE page_id = #{rowId}::integer
